integrity: Both quasi-cyclic codes are reconstructed exactly over \(\mathbb F_4\) from the printed polynomials. The complementary-pair rank, Euclidean dual \(D^\perp\), all \(4^9\) words of \(C\) and \(D^\perp\), and all \(2^{14}\) coordinate subsets used for generalized Hamming weights are checked exhaustively with finite-field arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the single \(n=14\), \(k=9\) Table 1 LCP with its printed generator polynomials. It does not classify all quaternary \([14,9,4]_4\) codes or all quasi-cyclic LCPs, and it makes no claim that abstract non-equivalence of quasi-cyclic LCP security sides is new.
title: Spectral asymmetry in an optimal quaternary quasi-cyclic LCP
